  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">

  </bpmn:collaboration>

    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="handler" name="Claims handler">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>checkInsured</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>insured</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>informReject</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>evaluate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>severity</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>sendSimple</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>sendComplex</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>returned</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>checkForms</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>complete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>informUpdate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>updated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="system" name="Claims Management system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>register</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>done</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Claim received" />
    <bpmn:task id="checkInsured" name="Check whether the claimant is insured" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="insured" name="Claimant insured?" />
    <bpmn:task id="informReject" name="Inform the claimant that the claim must be rejected" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="rejected" name="Claim rejected" />
    <bpmn:task id="evaluate" name="Evaluate the severity of the claim" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="severity" name="Claim simple or complex?" />
    <bpmn:task id="sendSimple" name="Send simple claim forms to the claimant" />
    <bpmn:task id="sendComplex" name="Send complex claim forms to the claimant" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="merge" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="returned" name="Forms returned">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="checkForms" name="Check the forms for completeness" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="complete" name="Forms provide all relevant details?" />
    <bpmn:task id="informUpdate" name="Inform the claimant to update the forms" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="updated" name="Updated forms received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="register" name="Register the claim in the Claims Management system" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="done" name="Claim registered" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="checkInsured" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="checkInsured" targetRef="insured" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" name="no" sourceRef="insured" targetRef="informReject" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" name="yes" sourceRef="insured" targetRef="evaluate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="informReject" targetRef="rejected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="evaluate" targetRef="severity" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" name="simple" sourceRef="severity" targetRef="sendSimple" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" name="complex" sourceRef="severity" targetRef="sendComplex" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="sendSimple" targetRef="merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="sendComplex" targetRef="merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="merge" targetRef="returned" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="returned" targetRef="checkForms" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" sourceRef="checkForms" targetRef="complete" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f14" name="yes" sourceRef="complete" targetRef="register" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f15" name="no" sourceRef="complete" targetRef="informUpdate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f16" sourceRef="informUpdate" targetRef="updated" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f17" sourceRef="updated" targetRef="checkForms" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f18" sourceRef="register" targetRef="done" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
